Regarding the physical therapy techniques for lateral epicondylitis (tennis elbow), the described plan is highly effective and aligns with current clinical best practices. Eccentric strengthening exercises for the wrist extensors are considered the gold standard in rehabilitation for this condition, as they promote collagen realignment and improve tendon load tolerance. Manual therapy can help reduce pain and improve tissue mobility, while ice therapy is appropriately used post-exercise to manage acute inflammation and pain. This multimodal approach addresses both the mechanical dysfunction and the inflammatory symptoms, supporting a comprehensive recovery.
